title: Week-7 trough projects $31K below buffer
narrative: The PO delay is a request, not a fact, until the suppliers confirm. The terms ask is a conversation Sourcer runs. Nothing here moves money by itself.

snooze.blocked_reason: This proposal has no deadline to defer.

execution.arming: Available from the Approve dial upward. At Suggest, a breach re-opens this card with the draw pre-selected and waits for you.

plan.name: PO timing to Planner
plan.meta: 2 POs moved week 7 → week 8 · cover recalculated · service level 96.1%

items.name: PO-4612 · Core cookware
items.detail: Confirmed date moves to Oct 13, four days after Amazon settles. Cover on three SKUs dips to 24 days at the crossover — inside the Core floor.

items.name: PO-4618 · filtration
items.detail: Meridian is already on an OTD watch, so the delay is requested with a firm confirm-by date rather than assumed.

items.name: Reorder points recalculated
items.detail: Planner re-runs cover for the affected SKUs at the new dates. If any drops under 21 days the request is withdrawn automatically.

plan.name: Terms brief to Sourcer
plan.meta: Net 45 → Net 60 ask added to the Kessler brief · answer by Oct 4

items.name: Terms ask added to the existing brief
items.detail: Kessler is already mid-negotiation on their price notice. The terms ask goes into the same letter rather than arriving as a second request a week later.

items.name: Cash value stated in the brief
items.detail: The brief now carries what the terms are worth to us — $31K of working capital per cycle — so the trade against price is visible to whoever runs the call.

items.name: Contingency if declined
items.detail: A no on Oct 4 leaves three days before the PO is due. The credit draw stays costed and ready as the fallback, and the card re-opens automatically.

plan.name: Settlement anomaly watches
plan.meta: 4 watches armed across the channels the plan depends on

items.name: Amazon reserve rate
items.detail: The plan assumes 7% held as rolling reserve. Every extra point costs about $1.4K of the Oct 12 payout, and the reserve is theirs to change.

items.name: Payout date drift
items.detail: A settlement landing two days late moves it past the week boundary and the trough deepens by the full payout. Watched daily from Oct 8.

items.name: Wholesale receivable ageing
items.detail: Two Faire invoices in week 8 are load-bearing. Anything past 35 days triggers a chase before it becomes a cash problem.

plan.name: Plan of record and reprojection
plan.meta: CASH-Q4-0071 · weekly Monday reprojection · Ledger entry

items.name: Plan filed to the Ledger
items.detail: Both levers, their costs, the two levers not used and why, and the buffer left unchanged at $120K. The next trough starts from this record.

items.name: Weekly reprojection scheduled
items.detail: Actual against plan every Monday, with the 13-week ladder rebuilt from live settlement data rather than from last week’s assumptions.

items.name: Unused levers kept costed
items.detail: Clearance acceleration and the credit draw stay priced and one click from ready. A reversal does not restart the analysis.
